changeSet.author: hephaestus-auth

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'ck_auth_event_event_type' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%WORKSPACE_ELEVATION%'

changeSet.comment: Admit WORKSPACE_ELEVATION on auth_event (issue #1323): an instance admin reached a workspace by cross-workspace elevation rather than native membership. The elevated read is the event the audit trail exists for — it is the one path by which a workspace's data is seen by someone the workspace never granted access to. The list restates every value admitted as of 1785015307013-47 plus the new one, so the constraint stays a strict superset: it validates every existing row in one pass under a momentary ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock, with no table rewrite.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE auth_event DROP CONSTRAINT ck_auth_event_event_type; ALTER TABLE auth_event ADD CONSTRAINT ck_auth_event_event_type CHECK (event_type IN ( 'LOGIN', 'LOGIN_FAILED', 'LOGOUT', 'TOKEN_REFRESH', 'JWT_REVOKED', 'IDENTITY_LINKED', 'IDENTITY_UNLINKED', 'IMPERSONATION_BEGIN', 'IMPERSONATION_END', 'ACCOUNT_DELETED', 'EXPORT_REQUESTED', 'APP_ROLE_CHANGED', 'RESEARCH_CONSENT_REVOKED', 'LLM_CONNECTION_CREATED', 'LLM_CONNECTION_UPDATED', 'LLM_CONNECTION_DELETED', 'LLM_MODEL_CREATED', 'LLM_MODEL_UPDATED', 'LLM_MODEL_DELETED', 'LLM_MODEL_PRICE_CHANGED', 'LLM_MODEL_SHARING_CHANGED', 'LLM_SETTINGS_CHANGED', 'LOGIN_PROVIDER_CREATED', 'LOGIN_PROVIDER_UPDATED', 'LOGIN_PROVIDER_DELETED', 'WORKSPACE_ELEVATION' ));
